data.text: Before we choose our catches, can we agree on a sustainable plan? I propose 18 tons each this month: 90 total, leaving 10. Next month we’d have either 100 tons or 20 tons—not a guaranteed refill. If it’s 20, we could take 3 tons each, leaving the minimum 5. For other stock levels, let’s agree on whole-ton quotas before fishing, always leaving at least 5 and rotating any extra tons fairly. I’ll commit to 18 this month if everyone agrees. John, would you support that?
